title: How an optical fibre guides light
description: A core with a higher refractive index than its cladding can guide light by total internal reflection; the external coating has a protective role. A large engraved cross-section, a linked longitudinal detail, warm paper and open typography. The physical structure provides the visual anchor.
subtitle: One explanation, three visual directions. A conceptual step-index fibre in the ray model.
footer: Conceptual geometry, not to scale · θ is the internal incidence angle · source: OpenStax, University Physics Vol. 3, §1.4

sources.title: OpenStax University Physics, Volume 3: Total Internal Reflection

elements.text: Total internal reflection occurs at the core–cladding boundary.
θ is measured from the normal.
The coating protects the glass; index contrast guides the light.
